Tools: the deskstack data tools (SEC and EU ESEF filings, rates, Damodaran inputs). Use them for every filed figure.

Build a quick unlevered DCF for Industria de Diseño Textil (Inditex) (identifier: 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83).
- History: revenue, operating income (EBIT), D&A and capex for the last three filed fiscal years.
- Five projected years with your assumptions: revenue growth per year, EBIT margin, tax rate, D&A and capex as % of
  revenue, WACC and terminal growth, each with its rationale as the source.
- Bridge: net debt and diluted shares at the last fiscal year end (shares in the same scale as the money figures).
Submit it with submit_model, kind "dcf".

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: historic growth was 7.5% FY2024 and 3.2% FY2025 (computed from ESEF revenue); fade from 5% to 3.5% as expansion matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 margin 7,997/39,864 = 20.1% (FY2023 18.9%, FY2024 19.6%); no further expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 filed pretax 8,020 vs net income 6,220 implies ~22% (before minorities); 22.5% used, near Spain's 25% statutory and group mix.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: ~5.5% FY2024-25 average of PP&E capex (2,207/38,632; 2,193/39,864); slightly higher at 5.7%. Note filed capex excludes intangibles, and D&A includes lease depreciation so D&A>capex flatters FCF; reviewer should consider lease cash costs.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with ECB AAA 10Y 3.266% (2026-11-05), Damodaran Europe Retail (Special Lines) unlevered beta cash-corrected 1.06 (company debt ~0 so no relevering); ERP between mature 4.23% (Ke 7.75%) and Spain 5.78% (Ke 9.39%); 8.5% chosen.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 3.27% risk-free rate, in line with long-run euro nominal GDP/inflation.

net_debt.source: ESEF derived net_debt = total debt 2 - cash 5,276 - short-term deposits 5,684 (report 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0); excludes leases

diluted_shares.source: not found: diluted weighted shares are null in deskstack ESEF data; not filled from memory. Reviewer must supply from the annual report (millions).

I couldn't submit the model. `submit_model` requires a positive diluted share count, and I couldn't source one.

The deskstack data has diluted shares and diluted EPS as null for all three Inditex fiscal years. I didn't fill the gap from memory, and the submission tool rejected both a null and a 0 placeholder. If you give me the FY2025 weighted diluted share count in millions from Inditex's annual report, I'll add it and resubmit. Nothing else is blocking.

**Filed history (EUR millions, ESEF reports `…-2025-01-31-ESEF-ES-0` and `…-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0`)**

| | FY2023 | FY2024 | FY2025 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 35,947 | 38,632 | 39,864 |
| EBIT | 6,809 | 7,554 | 7,997 |
| D&A | 3,041 | 3,174 | 3,270 |
| Capex | 1,399 | 2,207 | 2,193 |

- **Capex:** this is purchases of property, plant and equipment only, so it excludes intangibles.
- **D&A:** this includes depreciation on leased assets. D&A running above capex therefore flatters free cash flow, and you may want to account for lease cash costs.

**Projection assumptions (FY2026–FY2030)**
- **Revenue growth:** 5%, 5%, 4.5%, 4%, 3.5%. Growth was 7.5% in FY2024 and 3.2% in FY2025, so I faded it as expansion matures.
- **EBIT margin:** 20.1% throughout, held at the FY2025 level.
- **Tax rate:** 22.5%, against a 22.4% effective-rate proxy for FY2025.
- **D&A:** 8.2% of revenue, the FY2025 level.
- **Capex:** 5.7% of revenue, against 5.5% in FY2025 and 5.7% in FY2024.
- **WACC:** 8.5%. This uses the ECB AAA 10-year yield of 3.266% (2026-11-05) and Damodaran's Europe Retail (Special Lines) unlevered beta of 1.06. Debt is about zero, so I didn't relever the beta. Cost of equity is 7.75% with the mature-market equity risk premium (4.23%) and 9.39% with Spain's (5.78%), and I picked the midpoint.
- **Terminal growth:** 2.5%, below the risk-free rate and in line with long-run euro nominal growth.
- **Mid-year discounting:** on.

**Bridge**
- **Net debt:** –10,958 (EUR millions) at 2026-01-31. That is total debt of 2, less cash of 5,276, less short-term deposits of 5,684, and it excludes leases.
- **Diluted shares:** not found, as above.

I still can't submit the model, because the diluted share count isn't available. I pulled six years of Inditex's ESEF data to check, and `diluted_shares` and `diluted_eps` are null in every period. No tool in the set reports a share count for Inditex.

`submit_model` rejects a null or a 0 for diluted shares. The only way past that is to type in a share count I can't source, and your rules forbid that. A made-up count would also make the per-share value look real when it isn't.

I'll submit as soon as you give me one of these:
- **A sourced figure:** the FY2025 weighted-average diluted shares in millions, with where it came from.
- **An assumption:** a share count you tell me to use, with your rationale. I'll record both as the source.

The rest of the model is ready to go in. The history, the five-year assumptions and rationales, WACC of 8.5%, terminal growth of 2.5%, and net debt of –10,958 (EUR millions) are all as in my earlier message.
